origins.section: Stop on Solutions, Not Seconds, When a Result Must Repeat
The Status Says Whether You Have Routes, Not Whether They Are Optimal
Local Search Improves Them, and a Metaheuristic Escapes Local Minima

recorded.prompt:q-status: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.

recorded.prompt:q-repeat:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-repeat:b: "a time limit makes the result depend on the machine". A longer limit is still a time limit, and there is no bound to show an optimum.
recorded.prompt:q-repeat:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-repeat:c: The time limit still stops the run, and "a time limit makes the result depend on the machine". The cure is a solution count.
recorded.prompt:q-repeat:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-repeat:d: lns_time_limit is also a time limit, and "a solution count is the repeatable stop".
recorded.prompt:q-status:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-status:a: "ROUTING_SUCCESS does not mean optimal: the greedy-descent column reports it for plans from 253 to 287."
recorded.prompt:q-status:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-status:b: "It does not compute a lower bound, so there is no gap ... to report".
recorded.prompt:q-status:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-status:c: SUCCESS means routes were found and the search ended normally. ROUTING_OPTIMAL means "solved to optimality", not a full plan, and none of the module's runs reported it.
recorded.prompt:q-greedy:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-greedy:a: "no single move improves it, but a very different plan may be better". Local minima are expected, not a bug.
recorded.prompt:q-greedy:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-greedy:c: Greedy descent "stops when no change does", and the runs were "never [stopped] by a clock".
recorded.prompt:q-greedy:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-greedy:d: Every strategy runs on the same model ("The model is lesson 4.8.3's"). Only the starting routes differ.
